notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44618934/21f4e3c57d881e1f016602edbacf5d105eb03210.png[/img]

Hey, W.A.N.D. wielders! 
Patch 1.0.2 is live, bringing gameplay tweaks, balance adjustments, and some new features to improve your experience. 

Here’s what’s new:

[b]🕹️ Gameplay Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Dash cooldown now starts after the dash finishes for smoother movement.
[*] Gain Essence and Heal effects only trigger on enemy hits (heal slightly buffed).
[*] Running Barrels will now spawn during the boss wave for added chaos!
[*] More enemies have been added to Shibuya after completion.
[/list]

[b]⚖️ Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Rina's movement speed and dash distance buffed for faster gameplay.
[*] Sonic Shield retrigger is stronger.
[*] Minimum dash cooldown slightly increased for better pacing.
[*] Cast with Dash skill buffed to encourage faster spell-casting combos.
[/list]

[b]🌐 Localization[/b]
[list]
[*] Japanese localization updated to improve accuracy and immersion.
[/list]

[b]⚙️ New Options[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an option to disable dialogues for a faster-paced experience.
[*] Screen mode options added (Windowed, Fullscreen, Borderless).
[/list]

[b]🛠️ Minor Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game threw an error if the gamepad disconnected during the intro.
[*] Running Barrels will now respawn with a slight delay to avoid instant chaos.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
We hope these updates make your spell-crafting journey even more enjoyable! ✨ 
If you have any feedback, drop it in the comments or discussions.

As always, thank you for your support, and happy spell-crafting! 💖
